    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    # The source pattern is an overlay stamp: stamp at matching zero sites only.
    # Prefer exact placements where the whole footprint is zero; do not mutate source cells.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); placements=[]

        cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
        if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells): placements.append(cells)
    # stamp placed in every viable position, consistently using original background
    for cells in placements:
      for rr,cc in cells: g[rr][cc]=7
    return g
'''
print(write_file(p,s))
